signals.title: action-state-group/agent-action-capsule
signals.content: Agent Action Capsule — an open SCITT statement profile for recording and verifying what an AI agent did (draft-mih-scitt-agent-action-capsule)
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: action-state-group/agent-action-capsule

Agent Action Capsule – an open SCITT (Self‑Contained, Immutable, Trustworthy, and Transparent) statement profile designed to record and verify AI agent activities. The draft specification (mih‑scitt‑agent‑action‑capsule) outlines a minimal data model: agent identifier, timestamp, action type, input parameters, output artifacts, and cryptographic proof of integrity. Intended for OSINT and audit workflows, it enables third‑party verification without exposing proprietary model internals. Adoption is pending community review; current implementations are experimental and limited to sandbox environments.

Pyongyang claimed its weapons achieved perfect accuracy during the demonstration, a claim not independently verified. This wasn’t an actual attack on American troops. It was a deliberate military show of force showcasing weapons designed to threaten U.S. and allied forces. How should Washington and Seoul strengthen drone defenses and deterrence as North Korea expands its unmanned military capabilities?
